science.title: A novel interval valued Fermatean fuzzy FUCA approach to assess entrepreneurship education and career planning
science.description: Entrepreneurship education and career planning play a crucial role in equipping learners with the skills, adaptability, and strategic insight required in today’s dynamic labor market. However, the evaluation of entrepreneurship education and career planning strategies remains a challenging decision-making problem due to the presence of multiple conflicting criteria, uncertainty, expert hesitation, and subjective assessments. Furthermore, there is a lack of a robust multicriteria decision-making (MCDM) framework capable of simultaneously handling interval-valued Fermatean fuzzy uncertainty and stable ranking behavior in such educational decision environments. This paper proposes a novel Interval-Valued Fermatean Fuzzy Faire Un Choix Adequat (IVFF-FUCA) method to address these challenges and provide a reliable decision-support framework. The proposed approach integrates IVFF information with the FUCA mechanism to effectively capture uncertainty and hesitation while generating stable and discriminative rankings of alternatives. The case study presents a hypothetical scenario involving four decision-makers, seven criteria, and fifteen alternative strategies, where benefit criteria include entrepreneurial skill development, career readiness, adaptability, leadership enhancement, and innovation integration, while cost criteria include implementation cost and resource/time consumption. The IVFF-FUCA approach aggregates expert judgments, prioritizes alternatives, and manages uncertainty throughout the evaluation process. Sensitivity and stability analyses demonstrate that the obtained rankings remain robust under variations in decision-maker weights and criterion importance. Comparative analysis with existing IVFF-based MCDM approaches further confirms the superior discrimination capability and ranking stability of the proposed method. The findings identify high-performing strategies, including Policy-Driven Entrepreneurship Education Models and AI-Based Career Guidance Systems, and provide useful insights for educators, career advisors, and policymakers. The main contribution of this study is the development of a new IVFF-FUCA decision-making framework that extends the applicability of FUCA under IVFF environments for evaluating entrepreneurship education and career planning strategies under uncertainty.

science.title: Six Research Projects Work Together To Reduce The Lag Between Biodiversity Data And Action
science.description: Biodiversity is enormously diverse, unevenly observed, and constantly in motion across space and time. This makes it far harder to monitor than many other parts of the environment. As a result, managing biodiversity often depends on information that is incomplete, delayed or unevenly distributed. At the very moment when rapid change makes timely knowledge more valuable, the systems for collecting, identifying, publishing, and using biodiversity data often struggle to keep pace.
